{{Quote|What is the Talus and Tralus Liberation Party?"<br />"They're a fringe group that espouses secession from the 'Five Brothers' group of planets in the Corellia System.|A spacer and [[Haleen Snowline]]|<ref name="SWG:HS" />}}
The '''Tralus and Talus Liberation Party''', colloquially referred to as the '''TraTaLibbers''', or the '''TTLP''', was a political movement active in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and the [[Corellian Crisis|First Corellian Insurrection]]. They advocated that the [[Double Worlds]] [[Tralus/Legends|Tralus]] and [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] separate from the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Diktat|government]] and rule themselves independently.<ref name="SaC" />

==History==
{{Quote|Terrorists from the fringe Talus and Tralus Liberation Party have stolen valuable state secrets. I urge you to retrieve these secrets and resolve this situation regarding these insurgents.|Haleen Snowline, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:HS" />}}
During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Tralus and Talus Liberation Party was in conflict with Corellian local authorities, namely the [[Corellian Security Force]] and the [[Federation of the Double Worlds]], as well as with the [[Aa'kuan]] anarchists on Talus.<ref name="FS">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=Faction%20Standings|text=Faction Standings}}</ref> Another similar movement was the [[Two Worlders]].<ref name="SaC" />

[[File:TTLP_soldiers_2.jpg|thumb|left|250px|[[TTLP soldiers]].]]
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Talus and Tralus Liberation Party acquired evidence that the [[Prime Minister/Legends|Prime Minister]] of Talus [[Hagrin Zeed]] was involved in various criminal activities. They first blackmailed the politician but then considered to publicly reveal Zeed's wrongdoings. The Talusian government therefore designated the TTLP as a [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] organization.<ref name="SWG:HS" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the Talusian [[Minister of Protocol]] [[Haleen Snowline]] hired a spacer to murder TTLP members and retrieve the incriminating evidence.<ref name="SWG:HS" />

The same year, the Liberation Party wanted to create an alliance with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The TTLP shipped weapons, medical equipment and valuable artifacts to a Rebel [[Weapons Depot|weapons depot]] on Talus in order to obtain Alliance support. Around the same time, [[TTLP soldiers]] were involved in the robbing of [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] graves on Talus. They were eventually stopped when the the Aqualish [[Omkoo]] hired a spacer who fought several TTLP soldiers at an ancient [[Aqualish gravesite]] and retrieved all stolen Aqualish artifacts.<ref name="SWG:GR">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=general|Grave Robbers|Talus}}</ref>

The Tralus and Talus Liberation Party was still active in [[18 ABY/Legends|18 ABY]], during the [[Corellian Crisis|Starbuster Plot]], but the TraTaLibbers were not involved in the conflict.<ref name="SaC" />
